faqs.q: Do I need to create an account?
faqs.a: No account is needed. Visit Chatrio, choose a nickname (or stay as "Stranger"), pick your interests, and click New Chat. No email, no password, no profile required.

faqs.q: Is my chat history saved anywhere?
faqs.a: No. Messages are delivered in real time but never stored on Chatrio's servers. The moment you close the chat, your conversation is gone permanently.
Pick interests like gaming, music, travel, or fitness. Chatrio pairs you with someone who selected the same or similar topics, so you always have something to talk about.

faqs.q: Can I talk to strangers online for free?
faqs.a: Yes. Chatrio lets you talk to strangers online free — no sign-up, no app, and no payment. Just set a nickname, pick your interests, and hit New Chat to connect with someone new instantly.

faqs.q: Is Chatrio a good Omegle alternative?
faqs.a: Chatrio launched as a modern alternative to Omegle, with a cleaner mobile-first interface, interest-based matching, photo sharing, and a stronger commitment to privacy.

faqs.q: How does Chatrio handle inappropriate content?
faqs.a: Users can report inappropriate behavior with one click. Repeated violations result in bans. Automated filters also detect and block the most harmful content categories.

faqs.q: Can I use Chatrio on my phone?
faqs.a: Yes. Chatrio is fully responsive and works on any modern smartphone browser — iOS Safari and Android Chrome included. No app download required.

faqs.q: What makes Chatrio different from other random chat sites?
faqs.a: Three things: instant connections (no waiting rooms), real interest matching (not just random pairing), and genuine privacy (no data stored, no accounts, no tracking).

Circles is Chatrio's newest feature — an anonymous local chat to meet people near you. Your location is only ever shared approximately (never exact), you send one intro message before a chat opens, and you can join local group rooms too. No account required.

faqs.q: Can I video chat on Chatrio?
faqs.a: Yes — two ways. Escalate any text chat to a live video call with one tap using the camera icon, or go straight to Random Video Chat for a match where video starts the instant you're connected. No account needed for either.
